summary_zh:
這裡建議至少停留 30 分鐘，如果想看到彩虹的話，建議中午過後來比較好。如果你時間更多的話，比如你有 1 小時以上，建議可以沿著旁邊的步道往上走，上方還有步行步道，再往前走 20 分鐘，可以看到 2-3 個小瀑布，如果你時間有限，至少保留 30 分鐘欣賞這個大瀑布。

旁邊有磨坊瀑布 Kvernufoss，也建議多留 1HR 前往。

旁邊有餐廳，旅館，新的停車場 2025 年啟用，付費後裡面有新的廁所使用。
summary_en:
It is recommended to spend at least 30 minutes here; if you want to see a rainbow, it’s best to visit after noon. If you have more time, such as over an hour, you can walk up the nearby trail for about 20 minutes to see 2–3 smaller waterfalls. If you are short on time, allocate at least 30 minutes to admire the main waterfall.

Nearby is Kvernufoss waterfall, which is also worth spending an additional hour to visit.

There are restaurants, hotels, and a new parking lot opening in 2025; the paid parking includes new restroom facilities.
